panels.title: 会画但不会按答题卡作答
panels.visual_metaphor: A capable painter whose free-form answers cannot be benchmarked
panels.prompt: Recurring yellow banana-shaped painter robot produces beautiful but format-inconsistent task-like images that a benchmark examiner cannot score.

panels.title: 教会可逆 RGB 答题协议
panels.visual_metaphor: A small set of protocol lessons mixed into a large art curriculum
panels.prompt: Same robot learns mask colors, an invertible RGB depth rail, and an RGB normal compass from a small stack of lessons.

panels.title: 一个模型、多个任务
panels.visual_metaphor: One shared hub generates five decodable answer cards
panels.prompt: Same robot turns one image and interchangeable prompts into five technically plausible RGB task outputs and decoder results.

panels.title: 强结果与边界同时出现
panels.visual_metaphor: A multi-lane benchmark race with both wins and visible weak spots
panels.prompt: Same robot competes with task specialists, performs strongly overall, but does not win every lane.

panels.title: 下一篇论文的问题
panels.visual_metaphor: Entangled pretraining and instruction layers under a magnifying glass
panels.prompt: Same robot is audited through controlled comparisons, uncertainty analysis, video consistency, and efficient distillation.
